text:
The bowl is a large steel mixing bowl, but the food covers only a small patch at the bottom, about 10 cm across. It looks like sliced red and green bell pepper strips plus a few cherry tomatoes.

Rough count: about 8 cherry tomatoes at roughly 15 g each is 120 g, and the pepper strips come to about 60 g. That gives a total of about 150 g.

Peppers and tomatoes run about 25 kcal per 100 g, so 150 g is roughly 40 kcal. There is no visible oil, though there may be a little, so I'll round up to about 45 kcal.

{"kcal": 45, "mass_g": 150}
